entries.speaker: Iida
entries.en: Niijima-senpai... Aren't you going to[n]help me?

entries.speaker: Iida
entries.en: You said you would keep it a secret,[n]but rumors have started getting out...

entries.speaker: Iida
entries.en: Wait... You didn't leak that information,[n]did you!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Calm down... They're still targeting you?

entries.speaker: Iida
entries.en: Even that delinquent found out.[n]He might try and threaten me too...

entries.speaker: Iida
entries.en: Why is this happening to me? I can't[n]afford to keep paying...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I've found some clues regarding your[n]incident. I just need you to wait a bit[n]longer.

entries.speaker: Iida
entries.en: You're really gonna help? Everyone[n]thinks you're just doing it for a letter[n]of recommendation...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That is not true. My goal here is to[n]protect the students of this school...
